subject: HearthHealth | Dedicated GPU pool onboarding & regional capacity alignment
summary: Handoff from sales to CS + infra for HearthHealth dedicated capacity. Covers GPU pool sizing, autoscale/burst policy parameters, regional preference, procurement items, and next-step owners and dates.
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <s.li@hearthhealth.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@hearthhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HearthHealth | Dedicated GPU pool onboarding & regional capacity alignment

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Congrats again on selecting Redwood Dedicated. I'm looping in Monica (CS lead) and Karthik (Deploy PM) to start the technical handoff and lock in the activation timeline. Before the kickoff call, quick asks so Monica's team can prepare: 

- Target steady-state throughput (tokens/sec or qps) and peak burst multiple you expect for initial 90 days.
- Preferred region(s) for primary and failover (you mentioned US-west during discovery; confirm if US-east required).
- Any regulatory constraints (data residency, VPC connectivity, custom KMS) we should include in the SOW.

Monica — attached is the signed MSA and the draft SOW (HH-activation-sow.pdf). I'd like to schedule the 60-minute technical kickoff on Thurs or Fri this week. Samantha/Tom, what windows work for you?

Next steps after kickoff: we’ll provide a proposed GPU pool sizing + autoscale/burst policy, an activation checklist, and an ops runbook for failover. 

Thanks,
Sean
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: HH-activation-sow.pdf (pdf)]

From: Samantha Li <s.li@hearthhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@hearthhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HearthHealth | Dedicated GPU pool onboarding & regional capacity alignment

Thanks Sean — happy to kick this off. A few quick answers: 

- Steady-state: ~45 concurrent inference streams (mostly 8k-context generative calls); estimate ~18k tokens/min aggregated.
- Peak burst: we expect traffic spikes ~3x during marketing campaigns for first month; longer-term target 1.5x.
- Region: Primary US-west (SFO), failover US-east (IAD); data must remain in US.
- Compliance: we need keys in our KMS (AWS KMS customer-managed) and SOC2 scope evidence; procurement will follow up with the vendor questionnaire.

Available windows for kickoff: Thu 28 Apr 10:00–11:30 PT or Fri 29 Apr 13:00–14:30 PT.

Tom, procurement will join once we firm up SOW and pricing.

Samantha Li
Head of Platform Engineering | HearthHealth

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <s.li@hearthhealth.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HearthHealth | Dedicated GPU pool onboarding & regional capacity alignment

Hi Samantha — great context, thank you. I've attached our onboarding checklist and an initial sizing worksheet (hh-dedicated-onboard-checklist.xlsx). Preliminary read: to support 45 concurrent 8k-context streams with 3x burst headroom, we'll propose a pool of 12 A100-ish units (or equivalent bfloat/quantized nodes) with autoscale settings to allow +2x burst headroom before invoking burst capacity.

Two clarifications before kickoff so Karthik can prep the activation runbook: 
1) Is there a firm RTO requirement when failing over between US-west and US-east (e.g., <60s, <5m)?
2) Will HearthHealth provide a VPC peering / transit gateway or should we plan a managed connector?

Proposed agenda for the kickoff (60 min):
- Introductions and contact owners (5m)
- Technical footprint & region constraints (10m)
- Pool sizing and autoscale/burst proposal (15m)
- Network/KMS/SEC & SOC2 evidence checklist (15m)
- Activation timeline & next actions (15m)

I'll hold Thu 28 10:00 PT — holding for you now. If that doesn't work we'll take Fri.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: hh-dedicated-onboard-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Samantha Li <s.li@hearthhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 Apr 2027 10:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HearthHealth | Dedicated GPU pool onboarding & regional capacity alignment

On Thu, Apr 28, 2027 at 10:12 AM Samantha Li <s.li@hearthhealth.com> wrote:
> Thu 28 Apr 10:00–11:30 PT works for us.

Thanks team — quick prep notes from my side ahead of the kickoff in 5 minutes: 

- I'll present the autoscale policy options (time-windowed vs. reactive queue depth), and a burst ladder that uses reserved units + on-demand burst with clear cost/leak metrics.
- We'll include a fallback policy that pins to a quantized model variant if capacity pressure persists beyond 10m.
- For failover RTO planning: we usually design for soft-failover sub-60s (graceful degraded latency) and full routing swap under 5m; Samantha if you have stricter SLAs let us know.
- Network: if you can provide VPC peering that's preferable for performance; managed connectors incur an ops lead time of ~3 business days.

See you on the call.

Karthik
Deploy PM | Redwood Inference

From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@hearthhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HearthHealth | Dedicated GPU pool onboarding & regional capacity alignment

Thanks everyone for the kickoff today — good session. Follow-ups from our side: 

- Procurement will send the executed PO by Tues 3 May; they'll also push the vendor security questionnaire (SOC2 + network diagrams).
- HearthHealth confirms US-only residency and we'll provide KMS key ARN by EOW (May 3).
- Action items we captured: 
  * Redwood: produce final pool sizing and autoscale policy doc (owner: Karthik) — due Fri 6 May.
  * Redwood: activation runbook + playbook for failover drills (owner: Monica) — due Mon 9 May.
  * HearthHealth: provide VPC peering details or confirm managed connector by Wed 4 May (owner: Tom).

Please reply if any of those dates are unrealistic. Otherwise we'll queue the PO.

Best,
Tom Reed
Director of Infrastructure | HearthHealth
